title: Apple May Soon Launch News Subscription Service
text:
Apple May Soon Launch News Subscription Service 
Apple may soon be adding a new subscription service. ????This time for news. ????According to Bloomberg, the company just bought a digital magazine subscription service Texture last month. ????Now, Apple plans on using their new asset to launch a news subscription service that will be tied into Apple news. ????The news subscription service is expected to launch in 2019 with the updated News App. ????Currently, apple news is a free app filled with a variety of news content. ????Looks like Apple customers who love news might have to add this into their budge??
